tagline.sw: Elewa chama, SACCO na akiba binafsi, kisha uone jinsi Bitcoin inavyoviimarisha.
tagline.en: Understand chamas, SACCOs and personal savings, then see how Bitcoin strengthens them.

description.sw: Anza na pesa, akiba, pochi na usalama. Kisha chagua akiba binafsi, vikundi vya akiba vya jamii au fedha za ushirika, na ujifunze kupima hatari, sheria na kumbukumbu kabla ya kuweka pesa. Huhitaji kujua programu.
description.en: Start with money, savings, wallets and safety. Then choose personal savings, community savings groups or cooperative finance, and learn to judge risks, rules and records before you put money in. No programming needed.

outcomes.sw: Jinsi vikundi vya mzunguko, vikundi vya kulimbikiza na SACCO vinavyoshughulikia pesa, na wapi kila kimoja kinaweza kushindwa
outcomes.en: How rotating groups, accumulating groups and SACCOs handle money, and where each one can fail

outcomes.sw: Maswali ya kuuliza kuhusu sheria, kumbukumbu na uongozi kabla ya kujiunga
outcomes.en: Questions to ask about rules, records and leadership before you join

outcomes.sw: Jinsi ya kulinganisha njia za kuweka akiba kwa gharama, upatikanaji na nani anadhibiti pesa
outcomes.en: How to compare savings options by cost, access and who controls the money

outcomes.sw: Jinsi ya kushikilia Bitcoin mwenyewe kwa usalama, na jinsi kikundi kinavyoweza kuitumia kwa sheria zilizo wazi
outcomes.en: How to hold Bitcoin safely yourself, and how a group can use it with clear rules

format.sw: Masomo manane mafupi ya utangulizi, kisha uchague fedha binafsi, za kikundi au za ushirika. Kila somo lina mfano wa kubuni, zoezi, maswali ya majadiliano na jaribio fupi. Hakuna pesa halisi inayotumika.
format.en: Eight short introductory lessons, then a choice of personal, community or cooperative finance. Every lesson has a fictional case, a worked activity, discussion questions and a short quiz. No real money is used.

audience.sw: Yeyote anayekaribia kujiunga au aliye tayari kwenye chama, SACCO au kikundi cha akiba, yeyote anayeweka akiba peke yake, na wanaoongoza au kufundisha kikundi. Huhitaji ujuzi wa kiufundi.
audience.en: Anyone about to join or already in a chama, SACCO or savings group, anyone saving on their own, and people who lead or teach a group. No technical background needed.

title.sw: Akiba binafsi na uhuru wa kifedha

description.sw: Misingi → mazoezi ya kati → mipango ya juu. Bajeti, uwezo wa kununua, upatikanaji, utunzaji na urithi. Chagua kwa maamuzi ya familia.
description.en: Foundations → intermediate practice → advanced planning. Budgeting, purchasing power, access, custody and succession. Choose this module for household decisions.

title.sw: Akiba ya jamii na fedha za pamoja

description.sw: Misingi → utawala na malipo → utunzaji na hazina za juu. Linganisha miundo na ujaribu hitilafu kwa vikundi vya kubuni.
description.en: Foundations → governance and payments → advanced group custody and treasury. Compare structures and rehearse failures with fictional groups.

title.sw: SACCO, vyama vya mikopo na fedha za ushirika
title.en: SACCOs, credit unions and cooperative finance

description.sw: Misingi → mali, madeni na udhibiti → sera na urejeshaji wa taasisi. Visa vya elimu havitoi ruhusa ya kushughulikia pesa za wanachama.
description.en: Foundations → balance sheets and controls → advanced institutional policy and recovery. Educational cases grant no permission to handle member funds.
